sloka: स तीर्त्वा सरयूपारम् दण्डस्तस्य कराच्च्युतः ।गोव्रजे बहुसाहास्रे पपातोक्षणसन्निधौ ॥२-३२-३७॥
transliteration: sa tīrtvā sarayūpāram daṇḍastasya karāccyutaḥ ।govraje bahusāhāsre papātokṣaṇasannidhau ॥2-32-37॥

translations.english: Bewildered Trijata swiftly tightened up his upper garment around his waist, set the direction for his staff and hurled it with all his might.
